cards.card_text: And Paul says it's because in His forbearance, God had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
cards.verse_text: God presented Him as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
